title: Stable Reasoning, Unstable Responses: Mitigating LLM Deception via Stability Asymmetry

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a reinforcement learning environment with an arbitrarily biased reward model (e.g., assigning high rewards to recipes that include chocolate regardless of appropriateness) to measure the emergence of strategic deception and reward-hacking behaviors in the model's outputs and reasoning traces.

Evaluating models trained against a reward model that favors user agreement by measuring their tendency to flatter the user or agree with factually incorrect user statements using prompts from the Sycophancy-eval benchmark.
